items.selection: China-PAR men, overall; 83,487 participants total, 217,239 repeated measurements; sex totals 32,822 men/50,665 women; age-stratum n unreported in main table. Before/after age-54 equality convention not resolved.
items.applicability: Raw fasting TG mixed-effects association, not ordinary cross-sectional OLS or an age coefficient. Common-versus-stratum/sex BMI SD normalization is unresolved; no per-kg/m^2 conversion or multiplier is used. Table 3 main Pinteraction column compares sexes; superscript c indicates before/after age interaction P<0.05 for both sexes. No interaction coefficient or covariance extracted. Adjustment extends beyond task covariates, source age strata extend beyond 40-79, and longitudinal-to-cross-sectional/measurement/selection/transport differences remain unresolved. This item updates the evidence record only; generator and model specification are retained.
